name: ppt-to-pptx
description: Restyle/rebuild an existing PowerPoint (.pptx) into a clean styled deck as a slide-for-slide mirror where nothing (text, figures, tables) is left behind. Two modes: (A) MKL lecture style with native OMML equations via ppt-mkl, transcribing screenshot equations to real text; (B) source-format-preserving — keep the exact source fonts/sizes/word-colours and only change the layout (two-column: text left, figures right), re-authoring text screenshots as real runs and rebuilding tables natively, verified by check-agents. Skills: `ppt-to-pptx-restyle`.
